chapter: Becoming a musician: ukulele, clarinet and the Boozaire Kings
title: Winning the Lyric Theatre amateur hour
summary: The Boozaire Kings stopped the show at the Lyric Theatre amateur hour with Little Liza Jane.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: But then we went to the Lyric Theatre. And the first time we worked there, we stopped the show. They had an amateur hour, and they used to have all the same little kids come every week. You've seen that.
The same little bunch of little (?)s...
